scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Barree umrii, warriin seenaa kana qajeelfama malee jedhan.
Moo’uun kana qajeelfamutti haasa’aa malee jedhan.
Haalka kana qajeelfamutti hojii malee jedhan.
Gosaa sirnaa baasuu danda’amuu malee jedhan.
Hundummaa ykn gosaa sirnaa (harka sirrii ta’ee) malee jedhan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Warriin seenaa baasuu sirnaa sirrii ta’uu barree umrii ni dhiphisu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyam, ni qajeelfame. Gosaa sirnaa haala dhiisuu jedhe sirrii ta’uun, namoota bira gaddisiisu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Qajeelfamummaan haasa’aa baay’ee baahudha. Biraa baahudhaaf kennagaan, hojii alaaniif sirnaa baasuuf godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Harka isaanitti argama, garuu deebii sirnaa baasuu hojii irra jiru jedhan. Sirrii tokkumsiisuu kennan hin taane.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyam, garuu hojjetti sirrii ta’uufi godha, haala sirnaa baasuu hojii alaaniif godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Haalummaa ni dhiisuu akkan godhame. Gaddisiisummaa ta’eeyyumsi, sirrii alaaniif godhaa ta’u malee dubbisi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyam, haala malee dubbisi. Guyyaa itti dhuma warra umrii ni dhipha.

scenario: Negotiating a minor disagreement
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kana malee tokko akkas jiru kan qabduu miti.
Seesaa keessatti argamanitti malee tokko qabuu miti.
Akkaataa kan ta’ee malees jiraachuu miti.
Mirkaneessaa tokko akkas jiru kan qabduu miti.
Ishee tokko akkas jiru kan qabduu miti.
Sirrii tokko akkas jiru kan qabduu miti.
Adhuun qabuu akkas jiru kan qabduu miti.
'Maybe' akkas jiru, garuu kan biraa jiraachuudha.
Ishee tokko hin jiran qabuu miti.
Malee tokko akkas jiru kan qabduu miti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I don't agree with your plan to go to the beach, though.
dialogue.translation: Plan kee baasuuf sirbaataa hin adhagin, garuu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we could change the time instead of changing the place.
dialogue.translation: Dhaabbataa guyyaa ishee cuqa’u deebii keessatti sirrii ishee cuqa’u dandeessan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not sure it's the best matter to discuss right now.
dialogue.translation: Akkaataa mirkanessa jaalalaa ta’ee, garuu adhuun sirrii kan biraa jiru miti.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we should just decide together without arguing.
dialogue.translation: Dhaabbataa guyyaa hin qajeelfamne ishee walqabsaa dandeessan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but I still think the plan has a problem, though.
dialogue.translation: Adhagin, garuu plan keessumma balaa jiraachuu ta’ee malees.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try a different plan, perhaps a picnic instead?
dialogue.translation: Dhaabbataa plan biraa walqabsaa dandeessan, dhaabbataa baasuu deebii keessatti?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, that could work without any problem. Let's do that, though.
dialogue.translation: Adhuun, akkaataa hin qajeelfamne ishee walqabsaa danda’u. Haata’in akkas jiruu malee.

scenario: Giving feedback on someone's work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kana malee hin jiru yoo hin dandaʼu godhuu miti.
Deebii godhaa. Gaafii: 'though' barruun walitti jiraachuu qaban yaadota keessatti kanaa haala dhaabbata.
Ajjeesa ykn amantii qajeelfama godhuu ykn qajeelfama godhuu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I’ve read your draft, but I haven’t finished the last section yet.
dialogue.translation: Gaffii kee baʼee, laikin yanas akkasuma hin kennin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That’s okay. The quality of the beginning is quite good, I think.
dialogue.translation: Adabii. Caafii qopheessaa dhiheessan miidhaa jira, haataʼu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree with that, though we need to improve the ending a lot.
dialogue.translation: Kana malee, garuu akkasuma hin kennin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, the result is not strong enough. However, your ideas are clear.
dialogue.translation: Haa, hojjii akkasuma hin kennin. Garuu, fikira keessaa miidhaa jira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. What else should I consider for the final version?
dialogue.translation: Gaarommaa. Akkasuma hin kennin?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It’s possible to add more examples, and provide more evidence for your claims.
dialogue.translation: Akkasuma hin kennin. Akkasuma hin kennin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I’ll work on that. Can you support me with the data?
dialogue.translation: Hundee, akkasuma hin kennin. Akkasuma hin kennin?

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Halamaa, haala koo kennitan dhaabbata hoji'aa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Kan bira si hinqabdi. Deebii kennitan haalaa seenaa godhaa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, deebii dhaabbata. Irra haalaa gurguruma godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee. Cabdisa irraa haalaa hin qabnu. Ta'u imaaliin shagee ittiin hojjetamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Gaarigarsii. Gurguruma godhuu akkam dhiheessuu qaba?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Akkuma 5-7 guyyaa qaba. Dhiyaataa irraa haalaa kennitan laabasaa godhaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Dhiyaataa ta'u. Masaas kooti gochaa gaarigarsii.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kana gochaa fi huluulluudhaaf kennuufi argama.
Gaffii baraa hinarginu; gaffii ba'aa kanarraa malee hinarginu.
Kan bira qabanii jiraachuu dha. Mana gochaa fi huluulluudhaaf kennuufi argama.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Maqaa dheeraa gaffiin keessatti hojjechuuf yaaddessan, garuu kanatti barumsaa barbaachisaa jiraatan hubadhu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. What kind of role would you like to reach in the future?
dialogue.translation: Kana haasaa dheeraa. Haasaa umrii keessan ga’uuf yaadachuu qabaa ta’u malee?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa tokko qabxuu yaadachuu qabaatanii waan yaaddessu; garuu guyyaa qabxuu dhiisuu akkasuma barbaachisaa jiraatan hubadhu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: Barumsaa sirrii tokkoo hojjetan qabduu dandeessu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Akkasuma yaadachuu qabaatanii waan yaaddessu. Guutummaa guyyaa tokkoo hinqabnu; akkasuma, mana barbaachisaa hojjetan dhufachuu qabaatanii waan yaaddessu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude. I'm sure you'll achieve everything you set your mind to.
dialogue.translation: Kana ajajaa adabaa. Yaada keessan hojjechuu qabate akkasumas hojjetaa hubadhu.

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Galchi walqixxummaa hojii qaba, garuu hundaa hojii hin qabdin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Kan kanatti. Gaarummaan keessanii fi goomira keessanitti wal qabda qajeelfama godhaa ta’ee jiru hubachu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Taanaan. Guyyaa tokko tokko hundummaa guutuu kan qabdu dubbifama godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, harkaa qabdu kanarratti qoosaa ta’eera. Sa’aa lamaa guyyaa hojii qaba’aa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: Hundummaan, eeyyee. Garuu dhiiraa keessan godhaa dhaabbataa, harkaa qabdu kan hin taane.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Dhaabbataa gaarummaa keessan sirrii ta’u danda’a. Yeroo hinka’in qajeelfama barumsaa godhaa ta’e, barbaachisa ykn du’aa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Kan kanatti. Gaarummaa keessan barumsaa godhaa ta’e hubadhu.

scenario: Describing a recent trip in detail
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How was your trip to the mountains last weekend?
dialogue.translation: Safar kee ta'u dhaabbata murtii lamaa keessatti haala qabdi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It was quite wonderful, but we arrived later than we expected because of the traffic.
dialogue.translation: Dhihaa ta'e, garuu safar haa ta'u malees haa isin hin kennine jiraachuun murtii dhiisuu keessaa ta'e.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you stay in a hotel or in a cabin?
dialogue.translation: Deebii keessatti jiruu malee mana qorichaa keessatti jiruu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We stayed in a small cabin with an amazing view of the lake.
dialogue.translation: Mana qoricha dhiiraa hojii baahuu ta'e gara bahaa keessatti jiruu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the weather was cloudy, did you still enjoy the experience?
dialogue.translation: Gaddisiis murtii dhiisuu ta'e, ta’umsaa haa ta'u malees dhihaa ta'e?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we decided to go hiking, and we had a wonderful time, however, the trail was quite steep.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, qixxa’uun dubartiin keessatti safar haa ta'u, garuu dhiiraa ta'e, mana danda’uu dhiiraa ta'e.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm glad you had such a good time. I love to travel to new places too.
dialogue.translation: Ta’umsaa dhihaa ta'u malees dhukkubnee jira. Safar haa ta'u malees deebiin baruu keessatti safar haa ta'u.

key_phrases.translation: safar haa ta'u malees haa isin hin kennine jiraachuun

scenario: Talking about environmental issues
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kanaa kan biraa hojjetan godhaa malee danda’u barbaachisaa ta’e jedha.
Barbaachisaa gammaduun sirrii haa ta’e barbaachuu keessan akkas jedhamu.
Hunduma kanaa kan biraa godhamu akkas jedha.
Guyyaa barbaachuu keessatti sirrii ta’e jedhamu. ‘The’ akkas jedhama.
Hunduma biraa kanatti himu akkas jedha.
Hunduma biraa tokko tokko ta’e himu akkas jedha. Fakkeenya ‘single-use’ (tokko tokko godhu).
Hunduma biraa godhaa ta’e jedha. Adverb kanaa kan biraa ta’e godha.
Deebii sirrii ta’e jedha. ‘Aun así’ akkas jedhamu.
Seenaa biraa keessatti ‘sin embargo’ akkas jedha. Seenaa biraa hedduu ‘aunque’ akkas jedha.
Hunduma biraa kanatti jijjiiramu akkas jedha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.
dialogue.translation: Adabbii polii maaljerrmanni guutu taanaan malee namoota hedduun barbaachisu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Taaneen. Adabbi himi tokko tokko godhu polii baggaa biraatiif godhamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Akkasii. Adabbi kansa guyyaa barbaachuu keessatti danda’u barbaachisaa godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: Haata’u, hundummaa guutamu keessatti barbaachuu danda’u sirrii ta’e?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.
dialogue.translation: Haata’u, boottolii biraa biraa godhaa godhu hunduma sirrii ta’e. Akkasumas adabbi kansa siiqii godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.
dialogue.translation: Akkasii himu. Adabbi kansa jijjiiramu, malees. Hundi hundumaa godha.

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Fanniin kanarra, haa ta'ee wal fakkiinsaa hin miidhagnee jiru hubachuudha.
Sana isaanii ta'e kana qabdu qofa.
Huma ta'e jechuudhaan hin taaneefachuu dhowwatu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa lamaa ta'e ibsa du'aa lamaan keessatti haaraa qaba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Kana fanniin guddaa ta'aa. Haaraa odoo barumsite?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Gammadaa fi deebiin barumsa, garuu hammaa magaalaa hundaa deebifama fakkiin ta'uudha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: Haaraa walii keessatti hamma isaa huma ta'uudha?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Huma hin taaneefachuu, garuu gammadaa ibsa lamaa lallabanii ta'uudha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Haata'u, guyyaa odoo fanniin keessan qabite?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Ibsa lamaa guyyaa, kanatti lallabanii, deebii harkisaa fi hojii-dhiifama sirrii ta'uun haaraa qaba.

scenario: Explaining why you changed your mind
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Gara fuulaa irra deebisuu godhamee kun walitti dhufuu dhiise.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Haqa? Maaliif? Gara qorattootiif kan bira ishee hin jiru dha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Haqa, godhaa ta'uun adabii gabaabsaa jiraatanii hubachuu dhiise, haqa, hamma xixinnoo barbaachisa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Garuu, gara qorattootiif adabii gabaabsaa jiraachuuf plan hin kennine?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Haa, garuu, gara qorattootiif adabii gabaabsaa jiraachuu danda'u dhiifama hubachuu dhiise. Gara qorattootiif guyyaa itti daatuu waa'ee Galaanichaa, mana dhiise.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Haqa, haqa. Garuu, adabii gabaabsaa jiraachuuf gara qorattootiif hamma xixinnoo barbaachisuu danda'u dha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Hima, dubbii adabii gabaabsaa jiraachuu danda'u dha. Gara qorattootiif adabii gabaabsaa jiraachuu danda'u dha. Galaanichaa adabii gabaabsaa jiraachuu danda'u dha!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yeroo hundaa’e tokko tokko kan mannaa, mitihinaa fi sirnaa isaaniiti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Yeroo hundaa’uun waggaa fi waggaa laallasuu kan danda’an sirnaa mitihinaa godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, akkasumas haala dhiibbaa tokko sirnaa deemannaa namootaa hin kennitanii godhi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Fakkeenyaaf, sirna keessan guddaa keessanii argachuudhaan gaddisaa ta’ee, yeroo hundaa’uun tokko tokko adabii qaba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Kan hin jedhanii namootaa sirnaa deebii kennu godha ta’us, sirnaa laalaa barumsuu jira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Kan arratti. Sirnaa hedduun murtii dhiyaatuu ta’u, godhaa akkasuma hin argamu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Haata’u malee, akkasii laallasa hanga keessanii erga dubbatan irra deebi’aa ta’e.

scenario: Discussing technology in daily life
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Shaafee baruu keessani Wi-Fi qixxeessu godhi, garuu seera sirnaa kaasi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Sahiil. Seera sirnaa baafni keessatti dhaabbata Wi-Fi akkasumas godhaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Ha’aa, nyalaa. Garuu baafni macaafii baruu dhaabbata godhi shanee keessan macaaf godhaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Kan biraa guutni, garuu baaterii hin arginiif dhaabbata baatee sirrii guutuu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Deemii kee hin ta’ee. Shashii akkasumas kan biraa? Akkasumas guyyaa muraasaa jiraatanii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Seera sirnaa keessatti wal qabduu danda’a. Akkasumas barumsa ta’uuf, shanee keessan isaan irra deebii guutachuu qabduu danda’a.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Galatoomi! Yeroo kan qindaa keessani intarnetii keessatti barumsa godhu godhaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: Maaltu keessumaa, masa keessumaa ta'u keessan irra jiraatanii kan argamuu akkas jedhu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Maaltu keessanii argite, garuu, namoonni tokko tokko godhuu keessatti hubachuuf godhuu dandeessu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: Kana malee maaltu keessanii argamuu danda'a. Kanas, himii namoonni tokko tokko godhuu keessatti hubachuuf godhuu dandeessu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Kana malee maaltu keessanii argamuu danda'a. Himii, namoonni tokko tokko godhuu keessatti hubachuuf godhuu dandeessu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Maaltu keessanii argamuu danda'a. Kana malee maaltu keessanii argamuu danda'a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Kana malee maaltu keessanii argamuu danda'a.

key_phrases.translation: Kana malee maaltu keessanii argamuu danda'a
Kana malee maaltu keessanii argamuu danda'a

scenario: Describing a person's character in depth
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kana malee keessan deebii qabnaa kennuuf godha.
Kana dhiiraa hin qabne dhiiraa ta’an godha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I really admire my sister because she is always honest, even when it's difficult.
dialogue.translation: Wanti deebiin isaa hin kennine isaa isaaniif godha kanaan isaaniif isaa isaaniif godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's great. My best friend is very brave – he once stood up to a bully at school.
dialogue.translation: Kana waan hunda. Nama hubachaa keessan dhiiraa ta’an godha – mana dhiiraa ta’an godha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, that takes courage. My sister is also generous and often helps our neighbors with their groceries.
dialogue.translation: Waan hunda, kana dhiiraa ta’an godha. Deebiin isaa barumsaa kan dhibbaa godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She sounds kind. My friend is usually patient, but he can get into a bad mood if he's tired.
dialogue.translation: Isaaniif hubachaa godha. Nama hubachaa keessan sababaa godha, garuu isaaniif dhiiraa ta’an godha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My sister is a bit shy at first, but once you know her, she's very friendly.
dialogue.translation: Isaaniif hubachaa godha. Deebiin isaa kubbadhaa godha, garuu isaaniif hubachaa godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's nice. My friend has a great sense of humor – he always makes me laugh.
dialogue.translation: Kana waan hunda. Nama hubachaa keessan hammaa humoraa godha – isaaniif hubachaa godha.

scenario: Talking about education and learning
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kana malee ykn qajeelaa kennuuf gaafata.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Ingiliffaan barumsaa keessaniif dhaabbataa barumsaa godhu godhee jiru hubadhu, malees garuu guyyaa hin jiru.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Maaliif nama fedha hin kennamne? Namoonni beelama dhaabachuu danda'a.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Haala malee guutamaa ta'ee, garuu walii tokko kan qabnu mararraa barumsa keenya nu kennamne?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Haata'u, barumsa keenya wal qabya biraa kanarraa gaaffii ta'e jechuudha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Beelaman keenyaa qoruma muraasaa hin kennamne.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa tokko tokko fedhuu dhaabachuu danda'a, muraasaa hin kennamne.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Deemnee wajjin haasa'aa. Guyyaa kana keessatti bal'isuu danda'u, naannoo barumsaa guutachuu danda'a!

key_phrases.phrase: Why don't you practice with me?

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Dubbii keessummaa qaban kan ta'ee, kana keessummaa 'agree on' (filannoo) jechuun qaban ta'u malee, kana keessatti qooda ta'a.
Kana keessatti 'dhihaa' jechuun qaban ta'u malee, 'duur' jechuun qaban hojjetaa.
Harka kana maleesuma tokko tokkoo malee barbaachisuu godha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa dura keessatti walitti danda'u fufaa guddaa kan danda'u.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Dhihaa ta'u malee, maaliif fufaa haaraa walitti danda'u godhaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Cabsiisuu keessan godhachuu qaba: guyyaa dura keessatti walitti danda'u godhaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Gammachiisuu godhaa, garuu namootaa hamma tokko filannoo godhaa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Isaaniin walitti danda'u godhaa, kanarra haa qixxa'uu danda'a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Plan haaraa. Haa qixxa'uu fufaa kana haaraa guyyaa haaraa fufaa.

scenario: Comparing two options for a trip
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kana keessan sirrii qixxuu hojjetu godhaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Haaraa keessan sirrii qixxuu dhiisuu hin dandeessu: baasuu mana qiyaaraa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Haata’u, baasuu qiyaaraa kan murtii, garuu dawwadhu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, garuu qiyaaraa qophaa’uu dhihaa, waan dogoggora jiru hubachuuf miidhaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Yeroo hanga’in, qiyaaraa haala dhaabbaa, haala dhaabbaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Garuu qiyaaraa dhihaa, baasuu keessum bagajjiin dhaabatu keessa deebi’u dandeessu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Inni waan ta’ee qabna. Haata’u baasuu keessa deebif kan qilleensu qophaa’uu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Haaraa, baasuu keessum deebi’u. Qophaa’uu qabnu waan sirrii qabanu godhaa.

scenario: Talking about social media habits
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kana malee (gargaaru) hanga kana isaa (gargaaru) qabna.
Social media keessatti namni tokko raawwatu.
Feed gargaarummaan kun godhate isaanii ta'u malee.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How often do you usually post on social media?
dialogue.translation: Social media keessatti dhiheessan wanti gargaraa ta'u?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa tokko tokko adabii keessatti herreguuf malee barbaachisaa keessatti feed keessan argachuu dhiisuu hin qabnu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?
dialogue.translation: Namoonni hedduun raawwachuu qabna?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, garuu guyyaa walii hanga dukkana raawwatu. Adabnee hanga guyyaa hedduun godhu hin dandeenye, hojii keessan sirrii ta'e.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.
dialogue.translation: Kan biraa ta'ee. Hojii keessan dhihaa ta'e gargaarummaa keessan namoonni hedduun godhanii irra deebisuu danda'a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.
dialogue.translation: Ta'u malee. Jireenya weebii keessatti guyyaa hin taaneen deebi'uu danda'a, akkasumas hojii keessan sirrii ta'e.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Maybe I should do that too.
dialogue.translation: Deebii kee. Akkasumas hojii keessan sirrii ta'e.

key_phrases.translation: jireenya weebii keessatti guyyaa hin taane

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Se usa para mencionar partes de algo.
En presentaciones, 'main point' es la idea central.
Se usa para pasar a la siguiente parte.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Tolee, eegaadha. Mataadhuu keessa nama tokko dhaabbataa lamaaniif tolaa guyyaa qixxa’aa ta’ee jiru.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: Kan kanatti aduun. Murtoo keessan waan tokkoo maqaa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Dhaabbata lamaanii keessatti guyyaa bara baasuu qixxa’aa irra deebi’ee dubbifame.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: Akka ta’ee waan guyyaa qabaachuu qabna?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa qixxa’aa, nama murtii dhaabbataa lamaanii keessatti godhameera.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Haala marketingiin baruu kan bira hin kennamu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, kun murtiin dabalataa ta’eera; guyyaa qixxa’aa nama jechuunis jechuudha.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kan kanarra qabdu yeroo kan biraatiin hojii qabduu miti.
Hundarra hojjeero: gaffii hinka hojii qabdu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: Hojii qabdu biraatiin hojjeessu? Kan biraatii akkaan futboolii keessaniif.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Haa, baasketiibolii beektu. Gaffii akkaan ta'u malees Lakers, kanis hojii tokko tokko jabeessu miti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: Hinka Celtics hojii qabanu guyyaa baraa, haa? Warri gurguddaa hin jiru qaban?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Haa, garuu illee. Hojii qabaa ta'anii akkaan hojii barbaachisaa qaba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Kana malee dhihaa. Barreeffame hojii playofii hojiidhaa kana keessu qabdu irratti hin kennin?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Yeroo tokko, garuu miti. Hojii qabaa hunda ta'anii akkaan qabdu kanis, gaarummaa keessanii kennuuf godhu.
